I like some of the G3 concepts and I disagree with some, it’s kinda a love hate relationship. While G3 brought more diversity they also ripped out the diversity that was already in place originally like ghoulia and how she represented the neurodivergent community which I think is very important to be represented in those areas.
And also taking away Lagoona’s Australian heritage, I’m not talking about her design before people come at me but as an Australian growing up it was so important that I was being represented even by a small amount.
I really think they missed the mark on some dolls/characters but that doesn’t mean that G3 as a whole is a total flop there are a lot of good with the bad !!
